summary: PASS on ALL 8 requested scenarios (LOCAL POD ONLY — http://localhost:8001 backend + http://localhost:3001 website, per Garry's directive). Backend: 13/13 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iter107_george_voice_and_planner.py green in 38s. (1) Planner safety-net: 5 parametrised state-check phrasings ('how many open support tickets?', 'what about now?', 'still 23 tickets?', 'any change to the tickets?', 'recount please') all produce an SSE stream containing plan+tools events with tool_calls including count_support_tickets. Even the pure follow-ups ('what about now?', 'any change to the tickets?') that had to be primed with a first ticket message pick up the topic via _forced_tool_hint()'s prior-turn fallback and inject count_support_tickets. (2) Synthesizer honesty: reply to 'How many open support tickets right now?' contains ZERO of the six banned stall phrases ('let me check', 'let me look', "i'll check again", 'give me a moment', 'one sec', 'get back to you'). (3) Voice endpoint /api/george/voice/speak: 5 parametrised persona inputs all return 200 audio/mpeg with the correct X-George-Voice header — george→onyx, georgia→nova, onyx→onyx (legacy), bogus→onyx (safe fallback), ''→onyx (safe fallback). Cache-Control on every response contains 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0' verbatim. Audio body > 200 bytes in every case. (4) Regression: /api/george/voice/transcribe accepts a silent 0.4s WAV upload (200 with transcript field), /api/mcgs/counts returns 200 dict. Frontend Playwright at http://localhost:3001/admin (Chromium 1440×900): admin login → /admin/bridge OK; clicked 'Ask George' → sheet opened with 'What needs my attention?' primed message and streamed a real reply mentioning 'Twenty-three support tickets are open'. COMPOSER MIC verified: aria-label='Talk to George', title='Talk to George', text='🎙️', disabled=false (was a disabled placeholder in the batch-2 report — now wired). NO 'coming soon' tooltip anywhere on the page (count=0). MINIMISE BEHAVIOUR verified — Esc key minimises to bottom-right pill 'George · 2 messages' with a pulsing red unread dot; pill click restores the full conversation (turns preserved); header '–' button also minimises correctly. COMPOSER LAYOUT verified — textarea auto-grew from 45px (1 row) to 140px on 6 lines of input, with computed max-height=140px (~4-line cap as specced), send/stop and mic buttons stayed bottom-aligned via flexShrink:0 footer + alignItems:flex-end. Backdrop-click minimise wasn't independently exercised in the same run (the prior '–' minimise had already closed the overlay) — code inspection at AskGeorgeSheet.tsx:309 confirms `<div style={overlay} onClick={() => setMinimised(true)}>` is present and the sheet's own `onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}` isolates it correctly, so this path is safe. TOP MIC untouched (no code churn in AskGeorgeBar.tsx per diff scope). No 500s, no CORS errors, no red-screen React errors during the run.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/services/george/chat.py:167-184 — _looks_like_state_question + _forced_tool_hint safety net is well-shaped: fires only when the Haiku planner returned an EMPTY tool_calls[] list, sets plan._forced_fresh_call=True (surfaced verbatim to the client on the plan SSE event), and clears any 'insufficient_data' so the synthesizer doesn't hedge. Topic detection at _TOPIC_TO_TOOL falls back to inspecting the last 6 turns for the same keyword, which is why 'what about now?' still resolves to count_support_tickets after a priming ticket question. Solid.

/app/backend/services/george/prompt.py:67-79 — OPERATING_RULES §9/11/12/13 clearly ban stall phrases and prescribe the exact honest fallback ('I couldn't retrieve the latest ticket count just now — want me to try again?'). Rule 12 explicitly forbids re-using an earlier number when the tool errors this turn. Well written.

/app/backend/mcgs_module.py:1561-1622 — /api/george/voice/speak persona→voice map is safe by default: any unrecognised or empty voice input falls through _PERSONA_MAP.get(requested, 'onyx'). Response object emits Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0 + X-George-Voice header on every path (including the fallback branch), so a stale nova clip can never be replayed for a george request. Response body is returned via FastAPI Response (not StreamingResponse), so Content-Length is set correctly and the client's <audio> element gets a real length.

/app/website/components/mcgs/AskGeorgeSheet.tsx:439 — frontend hardcodes `speakText(turn.content, 'george', 0.95)` (persona key, not voice id), matching the backend contract. Any client that tried to send 'onyx' or 'nova' explicitly would still get the correct voice back thanks to the server-side map, but the persona-key discipline is the right pattern.

/app/website/components/mcgs/AskGeorgeSheet.tsx:80-95 — unread-while-minimised counter increments on turns.length change while minimised and resets when the pill is re-opened; the resulting red dot on the pill (line 286-297) is a small pulsing 8x8 dot with 2px white halo — nicely legible over the pale-teal pill background.

/app/website/components/mcgs/AskGeorgeSheet.tsx:218-259 (toggleComposerMic) — mirrors AskGeorgeBar.tsx exactly (same useVoiceRecorder hook, same transcribeAudio call, same micError branching); the composer mic and top-bar mic are now behavioural twins.

/app/website/components/mcgs/AskGeorgeSheet.tsx:97-104 — textarea auto-grow effect is elegant: reset height to 'auto', measure scrollHeight, cap at 140px. Verified against a live 6-line input (initial 45px → grown 140px). MaxHeight:140 in inputStyle + overflowY:'auto' means content beyond ~4 lines scrolls internally. sheetFooter uses flexShrink:0 + alignItems:'flex-end' so mic and Send never jump.

success_rate.frontend: 7/7 verifiable scenarios PASS (composer mic wired, no coming-soon, Esc minimise, '–' minimise, pill reopen, unread dot, textarea auto-grow); backdrop-click path validated by code inspection only after the '–' path had already closed the overlay in the same run — no functional concern

context_for_next_testing_agent: The George stream endpoint the frontend actually hits is POST /api/george/chat (SSE) — the batch-2 review request called it '/api/mcgs/george/ask' which does not exist. The five SSE event kinds are session, plan, tools, delta, done (plus optional action_preview). Planner safety-net is verified by inspecting the `plan` frame's tool_calls[] for count_support_tickets AND (optionally) plan._forced_fresh_call=true — but note that if the raw Haiku planner already emitted the correct tool call on the first pass (which happens on unambiguous phrasings like 'How many open support tickets?'), _forced_fresh_call will be absent by design. That's not a failure; the safety-net is a fallback, not a required decoration. For voice: legacy raw voice ids ('onyx', 'nova', 'alloy', 'echo', 'ash', 'fable', 'sage', 'shimmer', 'coral') are all still honoured by _PERSONA_MAP for backwards-compat; anything else → 'onyx'.
